temporary_production_user: Not accessed or changed; preserved by not touching production.
data: Only fictional fixtures and the coordinator’s isolated temporary SQLite/TestClient company. No emails, messages, live accounts or live files.

implemented.problem: Homônimos eram apresentados só pelo nome em seletores, formulários e lista do RH.
implemented.change: Nome acompanhado do login já autorizado no diretório; fallback de ID real apenas para homônimos sem login. A busca admite nome, login e lotação; resultado vazio explica que o cadastro selecionado permanece aberto.
implemented.preserved: UUIDs, payloads, privacidade do diretório, permissões e dados do cadastro.

implemented.problem: A opção Toda a equipe removia a palavra selected indiscriminadamente do HTML, inclusive de nomes.
implemented.change: Geração explícita dos atributos selected, conservando o nome original e a escolha agregada.
implemented.preserved: Sem troca de pessoa, nomes ou IDs persistidos.

implemented.problem: Histórico sem mensagem explícita durante carregamento ou quando vazio; falha sem recuperação clara e foco no resultado.
implemented.change: Estados carregando/vazio/erro, orientação para nova tentativa e foco acessível. Mantida validação de sessão, rota, modal e formulário antes e depois da resposta. CSS permite quebra de textos longos.
implemented.preserved: Histórico salvo, limites de consulta, conteúdo escapado e auditoria.

implemented.problem: Região horizontal da cobertura não tinha nome acessível ligado ao título.
implemented.change: Região com aria-labelledby, tabindex e título identificado.
implemented.preserved: Cálculo de cobertura real do servidor; proposta não preenche vaga e escala não gera horas.

contract_correction.finding: The first HTTP run disproved the mocked UI135 assumption that editing a returned expense changes status to draft.
contract_correction.actual_contract: A new record starts as draft. Editing an existing returned claim preserves returned, its ID, attachments and review reason until explicit submit.
contract_correction.resolution: Corrected the new HTTP assertion and UI135 response fixture only in runtime-ui136; 236 UI135 checks rerun passed. Backend and status rules were not modified. Prior frozen UI135 artifacts were not rewritten.
contract_correction.initial_failure: One assertion expected draft but received returned; subsequent complete HTTP run passed 2/2.

contrast.scope: Computed contrast only for explicitly changed text/loading/focus colors. Not a full visual/browser accessibility audit.

translations: work/ui136-rh-translations.json (six keys; tests used real PT/EN dictionaries integrated by coordinator)

preview_generation.empty_profile_example: Private profile.people=[] is an illustrative unfilled profile. The directory, roster, coverage and expense/history are exact real fictional HTTP responses.
preview_generation.note: Previews are HTML, not screenshots. Controls disabled; standalone dialog wrapper adjusted. No browser opened.

limits: No visual/browser validation, device viewport validation, real keyboard navigation, native dialogs or screen reader validation.
The DOM adapter executes actual handlers but does not implement layout or native form validation; backend validation is exercised separately by two HTTP journeys.
Employee-private registration save and document verification use controlled DOM responses, not new full HTTP journeys in this phase.
Calendar month/agenda, profile/account outside HR and report export were not specifically rerun by this agent in UI136; previous evidence remains historical.
No production mutation, temporary-user change, external notification, payment, payroll calculation or deployment.
dependencies: Coordinator integrates translations, shell/cache/version, tests other areas and assembles the ZIP. RH source/test files are frozen; only documentation/previews in work were edited afterwards.
